notes.title: The first major version update is here! ! !
notes.notes:
[b]1.Hang up to get the function of gold coins[/b]
Players reported that it is difficult to obtain gold coins, so the hang-up function was added.
Players can hang up to get the gold coin function, and the hang up function can run in the background.

[b]2.Add new game characters[/b]
4 new roles have been added. (20 characters in total)
Will continue to be updated in the future, currently set as 30 available characters.

[b]3.Fix bugs[/b]
Fixed known bugs.

notes.title: The game has been updated and new characters have been added! !
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39944380/bfe789691beb06cccb2f7e918c2048ab81381017.png[/img]Recently, I have been working on other projects. Thank you for your long-term support. Today, I have updated a new role. There are currently 16 young ladies.
